question.md:
Return the length of the shortest stretch of consecutive jars that includes every flavour appearing on the
shelf.

- **n up to 10⁵**, flavours up to 10⁹.

think.md:
`jars = [7, 3, 7, 7, 9, 3, 3, 9, 7, 1, 3]` has 4 flavours; the shortest stretch with all of them has length **4**.

Adding jars never removes a flavour, so "contains everything" stays true when the window grows: for each right
end there's a latest left edge that still works, and it only moves right. That's the shrinking-window
pattern, with a counter of how many flavours are currently present.

idea.md: For each start, add jars to a set until it has all `d` flavours.

lines.text: `d` distinct flavours; the whole shelf always works.
Extend until every flavour is seen; only stretches shorter than the best are worth trying.

notes.c: `mark[f] = i + 1` means 'seen from start `i`', which avoids clearing an array per start.

lines.text: Sort a copy, remove duplicates, and find each flavour's position by binary search.

complexity.md: **Time O(n²)** in the worst case. **Space O(n).**

walk.title: There are 4 flavours. From each jar, extend until all of them are in the stretch.

limits.md: Each start rebuilds the seen set from scratch.

idea.md: `count[f]` for the window, `have` = flavours with a positive count. Add `jars[r]`; while `have == d`, record and remove `jars[left]`.

notes.c: Compress flavours to ids so the counts can be a plain array.

lines.text: Sort a copy, remove duplicates, and find each flavour's position by binary search.
Add jar `i`; a flavour going from 0 to 1 is newly present.
Complete window: record it, then drop the leftmost jar; if that was its flavour's last copy, the window is incomplete again.

complexity.md: **Time O(n)** expected (O(n log n) for C's compression). **Space O(n).**

steps.text: Add 1 (index 9). Valid: shrink while it stays valid (shortest ending here: 6..9, length 4).
Add 3 (index 10). Valid: shrink while it stays valid (shortest ending here: 7..10, length 4).

walk.title: Grow the window with flavour counts. Once it holds every flavour, record it and drop jars from the left until a flavour is missing.

takeaways.md:
- **Shortest window containing all kinds:** counts + a "kinds present" counter.
- Large keys: hash map, or compress to `0..d−1` once.
- Record inside the shrink loop: each recorded window is minimal for its right end.
